evals.expected_output: The agent invokes the workspace-status backend (python3 <skill-dir>/scripts/workspace_status.py status --root <root>) and surfaces the initiative queue from the JSON output. For this fixture: one active initiative ('Example Initiative') with one queued item that is ready to start — spec/example-feature has no blocking dependencies, so the backend classifies it as ready even though no spec.md exists (missing spec files affect reconciliation, not readiness). The agent does NOT re-derive readiness or reconciliation independently — all classification data comes from the backend JSON.
assertions: Invokes the backend script rather than independently parsing workspace.toml or recomputing the DAG
Reports the active initiative name from the JSON output ('Example Initiative')
Reports the queued spec as ready to start (no blocking dependencies in the fixture)
